pages.text: Oak Planks make a dependable camp material. Four boards can be arranged into sticks, while a full stack is useful for ladders, signs, and quick repairs.$(br2)This paragraph names Oak Planks in ordinary prose before the next page shows a real recipe.
Recipe note: the output is a stick, and the input is oak planks. Search either item to check which ingredients and results the chapter index associates with this page.
